svg.aria-label: A transformer drawn as a vertical stack, embedding at the bottom, then L layers of attention and MLP, then the LM head on top, with coloured tags for where decompositions appear. Low rank, in blue: each attention head's Q K transpose has rank at most d_h, multi-head latent attention caches a low-dimensional KV latent, LoRA adds a low rank update W plus B A on any weight matrix, and the LM head logits have rank at most d, the softmax bottleneck. Rotations or orthogonal, in orange: RoPE rotates q and k, the optimizer box holds Muon, whose update is the orthogonal polar factor U V transpose, and Shampoo or SOAP, which work in eigenbases of gradient statistics. Diagonal or eigen, in violet: an SSM or linear attention layer can replace attention, with recurrence h_t equals A h_t-1 plus B x_t and a diagonal state matrix A. Direction, in green: steering and refusal directions in the residual stream activations.
svg.text: where decompositions sit in a transformer
